description: This file contains the implementation of ReportsController, which manages report creation, retrieval, preview, and deletion in a web API. It includes methods for handling Word document templates, generating reports, and interacting with a database context.

classes.name: WordTemplateReplacer
classes.description: A static utility class for manipulating Word document templates, including replacing content controls, populating tables at bookmarks, and populating rich text lists.

classes.name: ReportRequestDto
classes.description: Data transfer object for report creation requests, containing project ID, report template ID, version name, and description.

classes.name: ReportsController
classes.description: API controller managing report lifecycle: creation, retrieval, preview, and deletion. Handles Word document processing and database interactions.

methods.name: ReplaceContentControls
methods.description: Replaces content controls in a Word document body with provided values based on tags.

methods.name: PopulateTableAtBookmark
methods.description: Populates a table in a Word document at a specified bookmark with provided row data.

methods.name: ReplaceSdtText
methods.description: Replaces the text in an SDT element with a specified value.

methods.name: PopulateRichTextList
methods.description: Populates a list of rich text entries in a Word document based on a template SDT and a list of items.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST to create a new report, process templates, and save attachments.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET to retrieve multiple reports or templates.

methods.name: PreviewReport
methods.description: Provides an HTML preview of a report for a given project ID.

methods.name: GetTemplates
methods.description: Retrieves report templates with optional limit.

methods.name: GetReportsInternal
methods.description: Internal method to query reports or templates from the database with limit and filter.

methods.name: DeleteOne
methods.description: Deletes a report by ID, with audit logging.
